security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Periodic fullscreen reminders to rest your eyes
bundle.longDescription: Screen Break interrupts screen usage at a configurable interval with a short fullscreen break, encouraging you to look away and focus on something in the distance. Everything stays on your machine.
